feed.title: Hubbell acquires Ventev for ~$73M (SEC)
feed.summary: Hubbell Incorporated acquired Alliance USAcqCo 2, Inc. (Ventev) in the first quarter of 2025 for approximately $73 million, net of cash acquired. This acquisition was sourced from Hubbell's Form 10-Q filing for the quarter ending September 30, 2025. The deal involved a carve-out of a Tessco division into Hubbell, with Ventev identified as a wireless infrastructure business.

feed.title: The Discontinued Campbell's Canned Soup Flavor That Left A Hole In Some Holiday Traditions
feed.summary: Campbell's has discontinued its cream of shrimp soup, disappointing many home cooks who relied on it for holiday recipes like shrimp dip and casserole. The soup, which reportedly disappeared from shelves in 2025, is no longer listed on the company's website. For those looking to recreate the flavor, alternatives include using Blue Runner's cream of shrimp soup, doctoring Campbell's cream of onion soup with shrimp and tomato puree, or making a scratch-made version.

feed.title: Amgen or Merck: Which Drugmaker Has the Stronger Dividend Growth Story?
feed.summary: This article compares Amgen (AMGN) and Merck (MRK) as dividend growth investments, concluding that Amgen offers a stronger dividend growth story. Amgen provides a higher current yield, more consistent and aggressive dividend raises, and a more diversified product portfolio, making its dividend more durable against future patent expirations. Merck, while having growth potential, relies heavily on its Keytruda franchise and faces challenges with its pipeline execution.

feed.title: Weyerhaeuser to discuss future plans at upcoming open houses
feed.summary: Weyerhaeuser is holding two open houses to discuss its future plans, including proposed updates to harvesting areas over the next decade. The company will also cover harvesting plans and strategies for reducing wildfire risks. The events are scheduled for September 21st in Centre 2000 and September 23rd at the Grande Cache Inn.

feed.title: Truist advances AI to create more meaningful client interactions
feed.summary: Truist Financial Corp. has fully deployed AI Call Summaries in its care centers, leveraging generative AI to automate note-taking and post-call documentation. This technology allows employees to focus more on client interactions, resolve issues faster, and provide personalized service. Since its implementation in Q3 2025, it has scaled significantly, saving over 36,000 hours in Q2 2026 by supporting more than 70% of inbound client interactions.

feed.title: Equinix Plans $5B-$7B Annual Data Center Buildout as AI Demand Accelerates
feed.summary: Equinix plans to invest $5 billion to $7 billion annually in data center development, primarily in existing markets, driven by accelerating AI adoption among enterprise customers. The company aims for cash-on-cash returns in the low 20% range and expects to significantly increase its power capacity under development. Executives emphasized a customer-centric approach, building infrastructure where demand is visible and preparing facilities for higher-density AI workloads.

feed.title: Coca-Cola accelerates US investments with $10 billion plan
feed.summary: The Coca-Cola Company and its bottling partners plan to invest $10 billion in U.S. infrastructure between 2026 and 2030, including new production, distribution, and office facilities. This investment builds on their existing network of over 70 production facilities and hundreds of distribution centers. The company also highlighted a study showing its system contributed $85 billion to the U.S. GDP in 2025, supported nearly 1 million jobs, and allocated $37 billion to U.S. suppliers.

feed.title: Carson Rowland Breaks Silence on 'Sweet Magnolias' Cancellation After Exit
feed.summary: Carson Rowland has commented on the cancellation of Netflix's "Sweet Magnolias" following his exit from the show. Netflix decided not to renew the series for a sixth season, instead ordering a new drama from the showrunner. Rowland had previously chosen not to reprise his role, with the show's creators leaving the door open for a potential return for his character.

feed.title: lululemon athletica (NASDAQ:LULU) Downgraded to "Strong Sell" Rating by Zacks Research

The company's recent quarterly earnings beat EPS estimates but missed revenue expectations, raising concerns about demand and future growth.

feed.title: Targa Resources (TRGP) Set a Record Quarter and Then Raised the Bar
feed.summary: Targa Resources (TRGP) reported a record second quarter with Adjusted EBITDA reaching $1.60 billion, a 38% increase year-over-year, driven by strong Permian Basin natural gas and NGL volumes. The company is actively expanding its infrastructure with new plants and fractionators, funding this growth with significant borrowing, which poses both opportunities and risks depending on market conditions. Hedge fund ownership increased, suggesting growing investor confidence despite the stock being priced for continued growth.

feed.title: Why Is the Market Reassessing STMicroelectronics (STM)?
feed.summary: The market is re-evaluating STMicroelectronics (STM) as the chip rebound expands beyond AI accelerators to include embedded and power applications, highlighting the company's focus on automotive and industrial semiconductors. This shift means attention is now on STM's operational position and its ability to demonstrate progress amidst changing market conditions, rather than just broader macro trends. The company's unique position in automotive and industrial semiconductors gives it distinct opportunities and challenges that differentiate it from other technology stocks.

feed.title: DataMeds AI Litigation Settlement Extinguishes ~$19 million In Liabilities and Retires 364,099 Common Shares
feed.summary: DataMeds AI has settled litigation related to outstanding debt and receivables from its 2023 Wellgistics transaction, eliminating approximately $19 million in balance-sheet liabilities for a cash payment of $450,000. As part of the settlement, the company also retired about 364,099 common shares. This resolution allows DataMeds AI to concentrate on its core healthcare technology and AI platforms.

feed.title: Fortinet (FTNT) Stock Could Be 22% Overvalued On New York Hub Opening
feed.summary: A Simply Wall St. analysis suggests that Fortinet (FTNT) stock might be overvalued by approximately 22% based on its discounted cash flow (DCF) valuation, despite its recent strong share price performance and the opening of a new Innovation Hub in New York. The article highlights that while the new hub could support future demand, the current share price of $169.84 already prices in a significant amount of this potential. The analysis presents both bull and bear case narratives, with some seeing the stock as undervalued and others as overvalued.

feed.title: Intercontinental Exchange stock edges higher as interest-rate leverage draws analyst focus
feed.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) stock is gaining attention from analysts due to its strong ties to interest rates through its fixed-income and mortgage-technology platforms. Despite trading at a premium compared to some peers, analysts and fair-value models project a mid-to-high teens percentage upside. This outlook is supported by resilient earnings and structural demand linked to interest rates, though potential rate cuts pose a risk.

feed.title: Royal Caribbean’s (RCL) $1.25B Debt Deal Hides A Bigger Story
feed.summary: Royal Caribbean (RCL) recently completed a $1.25 billion debt offering, which appears to be routine refinancing. However, this move highlights the company's significant debt obligations maturing in 2027 and 2028, and its continuous need for capital for new ships and destination projects, despite strong booking volumes. While earnings are growing, challenges such as flat third-quarter pricing and geopolitical impacts on bookings raise questions about future profitability.

feed.title: What Makes the Latest NiSource (NI) Story Different?
feed.summary: The article discusses how NiSource (NI), a company focused on regulated natural-gas and electric utilities, is currently drawing market attention due to higher bond yields refocusing on financing needs and regulated investment plans. It emphasizes that while the NYSE Composite provides context, the core of NiSource's story lies in its specific operations and the need for detailed company communication to validate this attention. The distinguishing factor for NiSource is its combination of utility operations and the market's re-evaluation of financial structures.

feed.title: Union Pacific stock gains after UBS upgrade and solid second quarter figures
feed.summary: Union Pacific (UNP) stock saw gains after UBS upgraded its rating to Buy and increased its price target to $339, projecting higher EPS for 2026 and 2027 than the broader Wall Street consensus. This upgrade follows strong second-quarter 2026 results where the company reported a 12% year-on-year revenue increase to $6.9 billion and a 6% rise in net profit to $2.0 billion. Despite a recent short-term pullback, analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" consensus, with an average target price of $327.72, indicating further upside potential for the railroad operator.

feed.title: Del PD Pumps acquired by Ingersoll Rand — $25.2M (SEC cash)

feed.title: FedEx Counts on Polish Billionaire to Crack Markets in Europe
feed.summary: FedEx is relying on Polish billionaire Rafal Brzoska and his company, InPost, to expand its presence in European markets. InPost, valued at approximately $9 billion, will maintain operational independence and Brzoska will remain CEO. This acquisition provides FedEx with InPost's extensive automated parcel locker infrastructure, strengthening its competitive position against other logistics giants in Europe.

feed.title: Kansas City's midtown Costco closes Oct. 1. It'll reopen next year — with no food court or pharmacy
feed.summary: The Costco store in Midtown Kansas City is closing on October 1st and will reopen next spring as a Costco Business Center. This conversion means the store will focus on supplies for restaurants, small shops, and offices, omitting many typical Costco offerings like the food court, pharmacy, clothing, and liquor sales. Despite local opposition, the change is proceeding, driven by the company's aim to optimize sales in a location that, while successful enough to repay public tax breaks early, reportedly underperformed in general merchandise compared to its strong liquor sales.

feed.title: Why Is Brown and Brown (BRO) Standing Apart From Its Peers?
feed.summary: Brown and Brown (BRO) is gaining market attention due to its focus on renewal activity and decentralized distribution within its insurance brokerage services, distinguishing it from other financial institutions. The market's current rotation towards defensive stories and software, away from rate-sensitive names, helps highlight BRO's unique position. The article suggests that while general market trends influence visibility, the company's specific operating model and potential for future focused updates are crucial for sustained interest.

feed.title: Who owns the most land in Georgia in 2026? It owns 10.4 million acres

Ware Charitable Foundation, detailing their acreage and primary activities.

feed.title: Dollar Tree shares key update on higher prices
feed.summary: Dollar Tree has confirmed that its multi-price strategy, which includes items up to $7, is permanent and not a temporary measure against inflation. This shift follows strong Q2 2026 earnings, with total sales growth of 7.0% driven by customers purchasing higher-priced items. The company views multi-pricing as a key driver for growth and increased profitability, despite moving away from its original $1 price point.

feed.title: What Analog Devices Earnings Beat Means For Shareholders
feed.summary: Analog Devices recently issued US$3 billion in unsecured senior notes, following stronger-than-expected quarterly results and guidance. This financing move is intended to support the company's industrial-focused growth plans, internal manufacturing, and R&D related to automation, AI, and electrification. The article discusses how this debt issuance and Analog Devices' industrial positioning could shape its long-term investment outlook, emphasizing the importance of balancing increased interest burdens with maintaining high-quality earnings.

feed.title: ResMed Inc. (RMD)’s Sleep Apnea Leadership Supports Growth Despite Rising Competitive Pressures

Investors are weighing ResMed's market leadership against these competitive and operational pressures, as well as the temporary suspension of Astral ventilator sales.
